header: The small picture of a news card (src/lib/live/thumb.ts says why and how): GET /api/live/thumb?u=: the picture, 360 x 240 (3:2), WebP, with a long cache. The address of a story's picture is found when the list is built (in the feed, on the story's own page, or at Bing; src/lib/live/pagePictures.ts), so this route never reads a story page. I read nothing else from the caller, and fetch only from the listed hosts, over https, with a time limit and a size ceiling. A refusal or a failure is a small 404 (kept for ten minutes, so that a broken address is not asked again at once): the then fails and the card shows its tile.

symbols.name: LONG
symbols.sig: const LONG = "public, max-age=86400, s-maxage=604800, stale-while-revalidate=86400, immutable"

symbols.name: made
doc: The pictures made recently, so that a server that has no shared cache in front of it (this one on a desk) does not make the same one twice.
